verdict.rationale: Privacy posture is a fair question for an IaC tool that handles sensitive state data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no data-retention or deletion controls. State/plan encryption at rest is an adjacent privacy control, not retention or deletion. Destroy mode removes provisioned infrastructure, not retained user data. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
